releases.name: OpenCode Pocket 0.1.1
releases.body:
## OpenCode Pocket 0.1.1

A stable update focused on using existing OpenCode sessions comfortably from your phone.

### Highlights

- **More reliable live status** — working sessions no longer flicker to **Stale** during ordinary background refreshes, and one brief event-stream reconnect is tolerated before showing a warning.
- **Better conversation navigation** — use **Latest** to return to the newest message; the title bar compacts while you read upward and stays out of the way while moving down.
- **Session model controls** — choose the OpenCode model and variant for an individual session directly in Pocket.
- **Improved Android composer** — the message box stays above the keyboard with less unnecessary empty space.
- **Clearer server details** — the server screen now calls the timestamp **Latest activity**.

### Install / upgrade

Download `opencode-pocket-0.1.1.apk` below and open it on Android. It is signed with the same release key as earlier Pocket builds, so it installs as an update over the release candidates.

### Compatibility

Pocket connects to OpenCode V2 servers. Model and variant controls appear when the connected server exposes available models.

releases.name: OpenCode Pocket v0.1.1-rc.4
releases.body:
## Conversation UX
- Add a Latest button when reading earlier conversation content.
- Reveal the compact session bar while scrolling up; hide it while scrolling down.
- Keep the complete message composer above Android keyboard accessory strips.

## Validation
- `npm test` (99 passing)
- `npm run check`
- Installed the EAS-signed APK over RC.3 on a Samsung device and verified the composer with the keyboard open.

releases.name: OpenCode Pocket v0.1.1-rc.2
releases.body:
## Highlights
- Switch the model for an existing session from Session controls.
- Choose a server-provided model variant, including the default variant.
- Refresh the active session after a confirmed model change.

## Validation

- `npm run check`
- EAS Android preview build, verified as version 0.1.1-rc.2 (version code 3) and signed with the RC.1 release certificate.
